text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe achieved the Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown. She claimed the golden crown 
that Zenno Rob Roy had won in another 
universe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy says she is glad to have 
someone to aim for, because she can 
challenge them again and leave an even 
brighter brilliance behind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reaffirming their friendship, the two 
vowed to remain great rivals going 
forward.
